rationale: Agreements in restraint of trade are void; unrelated to builder deposits.
Repealed section.
Compensation for advances made on the strength of a false advertisement; mentions advances but not whether they may be taken before an agreement.
No booking or sale without registering the project; a related pre-sale restriction but not about deposits before the agreement.
When an agent's remuneration becomes due; unrelated.
Transfer of a project to a third party; not advance payments.
Adherence to sanctioned plans and defect liability; not advance payments.
Refund and compensation for delayed possession; not whether a deposit can precede the agreement.
A promoter may not take more than ten per cent of the cost as advance or application fee without first entering into a registered written agreement for sale.
District Collector inquires into class-wide consumer rights violations for the Central Authority; not the forum for an individual defective-goods complaint.
District Commission hears complaints up to one crore rupees and sets where the complaint may be instituted.
Who may file a complaint with the District Commission, including electronically, and the fee.
Pecuniary jurisdiction of the State Commission for higher-value complaints.
Pecuniary jurisdiction of the National Commission for the highest-value complaints.
Notices may be served by electronic means; electronic procedure but not filing of the complaint.
Experts to assist the Commissions; unrelated to online filing.
The proviso to section 35(1) allows a complaint to be filed electronically, and 35(2) allows electronic fee payment.
Central-State sharing of RTE funding; not capitation fees.
Applications to Mental Health Review Boards; unrelated.
Arbitral tribunal's lien for costs; unrelated.
State grants to the mental health authority; unrelated.
Foreign hospitality restriction; unrelated.
No school may collect a capitation fee or screen a child or parents for admission, with fines for contravention.
Sanction needed to prosecute capitation, recognition and norms offences; not physical punishment.
No board examination before completing elementary education; unrelated.
Prohibits physical punishment or mental harassment of any child, with disciplinary action for contravention.
Teachers not to be deployed on non-educational duties; unrelated.
Schools' free-education obligations and 25% quota; unrelated.
Sanction for prosecution of other RTE offences; not physical punishment.
Offence of child sexual abuse material online; unrelated to school punishment.
Duties of local authorities under the RTE Act; not physical punishment.
Teachers' duties and disciplinary action for default; about teachers but not the ban on physical punishment.
Prohibits physical punishment or mental harassment of any child, with disciplinary action for contravention.
Cancellation of FCRA certificates; 'certificate' in a different sense.
Norms and standards for school recognition; not admission without age proof.
Age is proved by birth certificate or other prescribed document, and no child may be denied admission for lack of age proof.
No child may be denied admission even after the extended admission period; a companion bar on denying admission.
Creditor's forbearance to sue does not discharge a surety; not about agreements without consideration.
Section 25 (agreement without consideration void, with its exceptions) is the direct answer but is not admitted.
